name: Chordia Therapeutics Inc.
summary: Chordia Therapeutics Inc. is a biotech company researching and developing anti-cancer drugs aimed at RNA deregulation stress in Japan. Its pipeline includes the CLK inhibitor CTX-712, the MALT1 inhibitor CTX-177, the CDK12 inhibitor CTX-439 and the GCN2 inhibitor CRD-1968099. It dates from 2017 and has its base in Fujisawa, Japan.
